body.name: calibrated centered Appell inversion
body.construction: Using the nonempty \(b_n(\alpha/4)\)-block partition in \(\operatorname{MOM}_{\alpha/4}\), set \(\widehat H_A=\operatorname{MOM}_{\alpha/4}(\{(Y_{A,i}-\widehat q(X_{A,i}))\widehat A_3(r_{A,i})\}_{i=1}^n)\), \(\widehat S_A=\operatorname{MOM}_{\alpha/4}(\{r_{A,i}\widehat A_3(r_{A,i})\}_{i=1}^n)\), \(a_A=8V_{\mathrm{env}}\{\varepsilon_{g,n}^3\varepsilon_{q,n}+\varepsilon_{g,n}^4+\rho_n(\alpha/16)\}+\rho_n(\alpha/4)\), and \(I_A=\{\theta\in[-C_{\mathrm{env}},C_{\mathrm{env}}]:|\widehat H_A-\theta\widehat S_A|\le a_A\}\).
